variants.label: Tag Browse Tree
variants.tooltip: Provides the ability to select tags from a tag provider and perform actions on them from the component events.

root.description: Configuration for the path from which the displaying folder/tag structure will start.

path.description: String value representing the "starting path" from which the tag structure will begin displaying.

enabled.description: Enables the visibility of the filter.

values.description: List of the selected tag paths in the order in which selection occurred.

refreshIcon.description: Display settings for the refresh icon.

visible.description: Visibility setting for the refresh icon.

path.description: Path to the icon used to represent the "refresh" action.

style.description: Style to apply to the refresh icon.

events.name: onNodeClick
events.description: This event is fired when a node is clicked in the tree.

path.description: Tag path of the node that was clicked.

name.description: Name of the node that was clicked.

events.name: onNodeDoubleClick
events.description: This event is fired when a node is double-clicked in the tree.

path.description: Tag path of the node that was clicked.

name.description: Name of the node that was clicked.

events.name: onNodeContextMenu
events.description: This event is fired when a node is right-clicked in the tree.

path.description: Tag path of the node that was clicked.

name.description: Name of the node that was clicked.

extensionFunctions.name: filterBrowseNode
extensionFunctions.description: Called for each tag before it is displayed in the tag browse tree. Return False to exclude the tag from displayed results.

arguments.name: node
arguments.description: The tag returned as type NodeBrowseInfo. See the Ignition JavaDocs for usage.
